concepts.description: One neutral handoff point between two plain chip trays with blank accompanying sheets. Product and lot scope illustrative; no printed identifiers or technical layout. Exact approved words only. Blank paper everywhere; no chart, tick, date, status, forecast curve, metric, technical chip UI, customer facility/marks or geography decoration. Keep full-width source paragraphs on white at least body-sized; shrink scene before type. Official logo once, exact category/sequence, no extra header label.
